name: sana
description: Use Sana to get answers and act in Workday without switching tools. Check time-off balances and submit requests, review pay, find policies, file expenses, or approve transactions. HR and finance self-service are live, with more as admins enable agents. Sana respects each person’s Workday permissions and approval chains. Requires a Workday UMSA. Beta: admins can apply for access here: https://forms.gle/pz138pmAUE8x92B46
